story.title: A Huntsville race and virtual challenge for HBCU STEM scholarships.
paragraphs: HBCU STEMER presents the Education Run as a fitness-driven effort to raise funds and awareness for HBCU STEM students.
The 2027 race brings participants to Oakwood University in Huntsville for a 5K and 1-mile family run/walk, while virtual 5K and half marathon participants can complete their miles throughout April.
The official mission is to educate, empower, and elevate HBCU STEM students through scholarships and career resources.

items.description: The event page highlights drive-in reach from Birmingham, Chattanooga, Nashville, Atlanta, Memphis, and Knoxville.

faqs.question: When is the in-person Huntsville race?
faqs.answer: The in-person 5K and 1-mile family run/walk are scheduled for Sunday, April 18, 2027, with an 8:30 AM CDT start.

faqs.question: What virtual options are available?
faqs.answer: The race includes a virtual 5K run/walk and a virtual half marathon run/walk, both completed on a participant's own course between April 1 and April 30.

faqs.question: What does registration include for the 5K?
faqs.answer: The 5K details list a premium tech T-shirt, commemorative finisher medal, six-week Rocket City Runners training program, swag bag, runner's bib, local discounts, team options, and fundraising tools.

faqs.question: What mission does the race support?
faqs.answer: HBCU STEMER states that the signature 5K supports its mission to educate, empower, and elevate HBCU STEM students through scholarships and career resources.
